Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Lalit Sharma and Ms. Suraiya Naaz,
learned counsel for the applicant.
2. Mr. Pratiroop Pandey, learned A.G.A. for
the State.
3. The present applicant 'Deepak Singh
Samant' S/o Khushal Singh seeking regular bail
in connection with Case Crime No. 06 of 2026,
wherein, he has been implicated and
chargesheeted for the offence punishable under
section 7 of the Prevention of Corruption Act,
1988 P.S. Vigilance Establishment Sector,
Haldwani, District Nainital.
4. By order dated 19.08.2026 the applicant was
granted short term bail for the period of one
month on the ground that his old aged mother is
admitted in a hospital. Now, today, learned
counsel for the applicant apprise that during
treatment the mother of the applicant died. Now,
he is pressing for regular bail on the ground that
the charge-sheet is already filed and there is no
need of any custodial interrogation and the entire
service record of the applicant is unblemished and
in the present case on the instance of the persons
who are indulged in illegal mining activity he has
been implicated. He also submits that the
applicant has no criminal antecedent.
5. On the other side, Mr. Pratiroop Pandey,
learned A.G.A. have not disputed that the charge-sheet is already filed and the applicant has no
criminal antecedent.
6. After hearing the submission as above and

the fact that earlier the applicant was granted
short term bail and as has been apprised the short
term bail is not misused, in such view of the
matter, instant bail application is allowed and the
short term bail granted on 19.08.2026 is made
absolute.
